name: Myst V: End of Ages
descr: 关于此游戏The Grand Finale of the greatest adventure!  Decide the fate of a civilization in this triumphant final chapter to the Myst saga.  Embark on an epic journey into the heart of a shattered empire as the only explorer who can still save it— or destroy it with the wrong choices.Whether you’re a longtime Myst fan or new to the series, the Grand Finale is an epic adventure you won’t want to miss.Key features:Developed by the original creators of Myst:  Rand Miller and Cyan Worlds bring you the ultimate chapter in a series already renowned as the pinnacle of adventure gaming.Explore vast 3D worlds with an easy click of the mouse:  Improved point-and-click interface offers several options to accommodate your exploration style.Interact with the world like never before:  The innovative new slate lets you communicate with mysterious creatures and manipulate the world around you.The characters of Myst brought to life:  New facial mapping technology brings characters to life with unprecedented emotion and expressiveness.
